as_told.title: CIA's Walter B. Smith on using UFOs for psychological warfare

plain: In 1953, the story goes, Walter B. Smith, then head of the CIA, wrote that the US should use the UFO phenomenon for psychological warfare against the Soviets, playing up the sightings to unsettle them during the Cold War. Michels tells this himself in three episodes and says there are similar leaked letters from Allen Dulles, another CIA chief. In one telling he is less sure, calling it a memo, dating it to 1952 or 1953, and saying only that Smith asked how to use the phenomenon. If it is true, the US government saw UFOs as a weapon of persuasion.
